text_block_list.text:
Today, on the Tokyo Racecourse, Narita
Brian is
running in the second race of the
Classic Triple
Crown tour—the Japanese
Derby.
I can't believe it's still morning.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Although it's early, the venue is already
filling up
with people.

Who do you think's gonna win this year's
Derby?
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
There's only one choice, isn't there?
Нарита Брайан,
of course. Anyone would
think so after the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Totally! I wouldn't want to run against
someone
like that if I was a racer.
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
You can tell she's something else just by
looking
at her. There's no doubt the
other racers are
afraid. I wouldn't be
surprised if some avoided the
race
altogether.
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What the... What the heck are they
talking
about?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It's plain to see just how much of an
impact she
made at the Satsuki Sho.

"Hey, did you see that one racer? She
was a total
beast on that final stretch."
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
"You mean Brian, right? I wonder if she'll
be at
the Derby too. I just messaged my
trainer so we
can talk about it."
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: "Sigh... Нарита Брайан..."
text_block_list.name: Both

text_block_list.text:
She's even got the other racers raving
about her.
Hey!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Don't let all the noise get to you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Where are we right now?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's right. And you got me here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Have some confidence.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The running techniques you've taught
me have
given me a joy I never knew
before.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The path you've shown me in
challenging the
Classic Triple Crown has
made me want to run as
hard as I can.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What is there to be worried about?
Nothing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Now, it's about time I head to the
paddock. Later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm really going. Don't you have anything
to say?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Get out there and give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.text: ...Hah. Of course.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Here comes Нарита Брайан! What kind of
race is in
store for us today?
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
...So she's finally here. The stage is set.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
...No way am I gonna lose! My trainer
prepared
me for this very moment!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely gonna win!
No matter
who I'm up against... I can do it!
text_block_list.name: Both

text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: (They're exactly right.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(If you decide to enter this race, you
have to
believe that you're going to win.
Nothing else
matters.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
